symptoms_patient: Bite or scratch from a dog, cat, or bat. Lick on broken skin. Wound is open or bleeding.
red_flags: Bites on the head or neck, bites on hands or genitals, multiple deep bites, bite from a stray or sickly animal, animal died or disappeared.
keywords: dog bite, cat scratch, rabies, animal bite, vaccine, shot, puppy, kitten, bat

symptoms_patient: Snakebite wound, drowsiness, weakness, drooping eyelids, difficulty swallowing or speaking.
red_flags: Difficulty breathing, inability to open eyes, paralysis, drooling, inability to speak, coma.
keywords: snake bite, cobra, paralysis, breathing, choking, weak, venom, poison

symptoms_patient: Snakebite wound with severe pain, rapid swelling, bruising around the bite.
red_flags: Vomiting blood, bleeding from gums or nose, black stools, severe belly pain, unable to pee (oliguria), fainting.
keywords: snake bite, viper, swelling, bleeding, bruising, vomit, blood, pain

symptoms_patient: Sting or puncture wound while in the ocean, intense burning pain, redness, whip-like marks on skin.
red_flags: Severe difficulty breathing, chest pain, excruciating pain unrelieved by first aid, sting from Box Jellyfish.
keywords: jellyfish, stingray, sting, ocean, beach, burn, vinegar, hot water, sea urchin

symptoms_patient: Redness spreading around an old bite wound, area feels hot, pus or discharge oozing from wound, increasing pain.
red_flags: High fever, red streaks spreading up the arm or leg, confusion, extreme weakness.
keywords: infection, pus, redness, swelling, fever, cat bite, dog bite, hot, throbbing

symptoms_patient: Sudden high fever accompanied by severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint pain, nausea, vomiting, or a rash.
red_flags: Dehydration signs (dry mouth, not urinating), inability to drink fluids, severe weakness.
keywords: dengue, fever, eye pain, rash, mosquito, ache, nausea, joint pain

symptoms_patient: Patient with fever who develops severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or visible bleeding.
red_flags: Severe stomach pain, persistent vomiting (cannot keep liquids down), rapid breathing, bleeding gums or nose, fatigue, restlessness, blood in vomit or stool, cold and clammy skin.
keywords: dengue, bleeding, vomit, stomach pain, breathing, shock, blood, gums

symptoms_patient: Abrupt onset of fever with severe joint pain (often in hands and feet), joint swelling, muscle pain, headache, nausea, fatigue, and rash.
red_flags: Joint pain so severe the patient cannot move or walk, symptoms in newborns, confusion or severe dehydration in elderly patients.
keywords: chikungunya, joint pain, swelling, fever, arthritis, bent over, rash

symptoms_patient: Mild fever, skin rash, red eyes (conjunctivitis) without pus, muscle and joint pain, malaise, or headache.
red_flags: Symptoms occurring during pregnancy (risk to baby), sudden weakness or paralysis in legs (Guillain-Barré syndrome signs).
keywords: zika, red eyes, rash, pregnancy, microcephaly, mosquito, fever

symptoms_patient: Fever, muscle pain (especially prominent backache), headache, loss of appetite, and nausea or vomiting.
red_flags: Yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice), dark urine, abdominal pain with vomiting, bleeding from the mouth, nose, eyes, or stomach.
keywords: yellow fever, jaundice, yellow eyes, back pain, bleeding, vomit, dark urine

symptoms_patient: This is for screening healthy people. No symptoms required, but ask if they have been coughing for 2 weeks or more.
red_flags: Coughing up blood, unexplained weight loss, night sweats, close contact with someone who has active TB.
keywords: tb, tuberculosis, cough, screening, chest x-ray, ppd, skin test

symptoms_patient: This is for screening healthy people. Recommended for all adults or those with specific risk factors.
red_flags: Unexplained chronic diarrhea, recurring fevers, rapid weight loss, white spots in mouth (thrush), history of unprotected high-risk sexual contact.
keywords: hiv, aids, screening, sexually transmitted, std, virus, immunodeficiency

symptoms_patient: This is for screening healthy adults, especially those pregnant or at higher risk (e.g., healthcare workers, dialysis patients).
red_flags: Yellowing of skin or eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pale stools, severe abdominal pain, abdominal swelling.
keywords: hepatitis b, liver, jaundice, screening, hepb, virus, std

symptoms_patient: This is for screening healthy adults, particularly pregnant women and high-risk individuals.
red_flags: Painless sores (chancre) on genitals or mouth, rash on palms or soles, patchy hair loss, vision changes.
keywords: syphilis, std, chancre, screening, rash, sexually transmitted, vdrl

symptoms_patient: Preventive measure. Recommended yearly for all adults, especially elderly and those with chronic conditions.
red_flags: High fever with difficulty breathing, chest pain, bluish lips, seizures, severe dehydration.
keywords: flu, influenza, vaccine, shot, prevention, yearly, cough, fever

symptoms_patient: Preventive measure. Recommended for adults aged 50 and above, or younger adults with chronic illnesses.
red_flags: High fever with shaking chills, coughing up rusty or green phlegm, sharp chest pain when breathing deeply, confusion.
keywords: pneumonia, vaccine, shot, pneumococcal, elderly, prevention, lungs

symptoms_patient: Painful or burning sensation when urinating, frequent urge to urinate but passing small amounts, lower abdominal or pelvic pain, cloudy or strong-smelling urine.
red_flags: Visible blood in urine (gross hematuria), high fever with chills, severe back or side pain (signs of kidney involvement), inability to urinate.
keywords: uti, bladder infection, pee pain, burning, frequency, cloudy urine, dysuria

symptoms_patient: High fever (>38°C), shaking chills, pain in the upper back or side (flank pain), nausea, and vomiting, often combined with painful urination.
red_flags: Persistent vomiting (cannot keep fluids down/oral intolerance), confusion or lethargy, severe dehydration (dizziness, dry mouth), signs of shock (cold/clammy skin, rapid heartbeat), pregnancy with fever.
keywords: kidney infection, back pain, flank pain, fever, vomiting, chills, pyelonephritis

symptoms_patient: Unexplained fever (especially in infants), strong-smelling urine, irritability, crying during urination, new bedwetting accidents in potty-trained children, vomiting, or poor feeding.
red_flags: High fever in an infant under 3 months, lethargy (very sleepy/hard to wake), severe dehydration (sunken soft spot, no tears), severe abdominal pain.
keywords: baby fever, smelly pee, bedwetting, crying pee, child uti, infant fever

symptoms_patient: Painful urination in men, difficulty starting urine flow, weak stream, dribbling, frequent urination at night, or pelvic/perineal pain.
red_flags: Complete inability to urinate (urinary retention), severe pain in the testicles or perineum, high fever with chills, catheter blockage.
keywords: male uti, weak stream, prostate, retention, painful pee man, catheter

symptoms_patient: Repeated episodes (2 or more in 6 months, or 3 in a year) of burning urination, urgency, and frequency that typically resolve with treatment but return.
red_flags: Symptoms returning immediately after antibiotics finish, persistent visible blood in urine, unintended weight loss, lump in the abdomen.
keywords: chronic uti, recurrent infection, constant uti, bladder pain, repeat infection

symptoms_patient: Pregnant patient experiencing painful urination, frequent urge to pee, cloudy urine, or lower belly pressure.
red_flags: Fever (>38°C), flank/back pain (risk of premature labor), uterine contractions, vaginal bleeding, decreased fetal movement.
keywords: pregnant uti, pregnancy pain, burning pee pregnant, cloudy urine pregnancy
